name: Loudness out of Bounds
hint: A loudness comparison outside 0–100 uses a value the sensor cannot report, so sound-responsive behaviour may never trigger as intended.
instruction: Keep loudness thresholds and validated readings within the 0–100 interval before making decisions.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB loudness :: sensing) > (150)> then
say [Invalid loudness]
end
